how.signal: Opens a position on each Sentinel signal that passes your filters and exits at the signal's targets or stop.
how.dca: Opens with a base order, adds safety orders as the price moves against it, and closes the whole position at one take-profit on the average price.

how.tradingview: Runs your own TradingView alerts: indicator or strategy alerts reach the app through Sentinel's relay and open, close or reverse one USDT-M futures position per pair, within the limits you set.

field.action: action: buy (long), sell (short, futures), close (closes the TradingView bot's own position on the pair).
field.symbol: symbol: {{ticker}} or a pair. BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P, BTCUSDT.P and BTCUSDTPERP read as BTCUSDT futures; renamed pairs such as 1000PEPEUSDT are matched. USDT pairs only.
field.levels: tp or tp_pct, and sl or sl_pct: exactly one of each for an entry. tp and sl are prices.
field.pct: tp_pct and sl_pct are percent distances from the price: on a Live bot from the real fill, then re-checked there. Long: tp = price × (1 + tp_pct/100), sl = price × (1 − sl_pct/100). Short: the other way round.
field.bot: bot: futures (default, the TradingView bot) or spot (the Spot bot, paper, long-only). A .P symbol cannot go to spot.
field.size: size_usdt: optional notional in USDT, at most the bot's maximum per alert. Without it, that maximum.
field.stale: An alert older than the bot's stale window on the server's clock is not executed. Plain text or other JSON is listed as unreadable.

rangeExit.wait: The grid keeps its position and places no orders outside the range; it trades again when price comes back.
rangeExit.close: Closes the position at market when price trades the stop distance beyond the range. The bot then stops.
rangeExit.restartRelative: Closes the position at market when price trades the stop distance beyond the range, then opens a new grid around the new price after the cooldown.
rangeExit.restartAbsolute: Closes the position at market when price trades the stop distance beyond the range, then opens the same range again once price is back inside the stop band (checked every hour).

hint.trailingUp: Long grids only: the range follows price up and the upper stop is off.
hint.gridTp: Closes the cycle when its profit reaches this share of the cycle budget.
hint.startPrice: Fires when a 1-minute candle touches the price; the cycle opens on the next candle. Already past it: fires on the first candle.
hint.afterStop: Off: the bot stops after a stop loss or grid stop.
hint.priceBand: No new cycle while the start price is outside this band.
hint.endAt: Open cycles still run to their exit.
hint.ddStop: Closes the cycle and stops the bot at this loss from its equity peak.
hint.btcGate: No new cycle while Sentinel reports a BTC break. Open cycles continue.
hint.portfolioBreakerOff: Outside the portfolio breaker: not counted, not closed or held when it trips.
hint.maxDuration: Closes the cycle at market when reached. A running bot starts the next cycle after the cooldown.
